title: Is Lightning Hotter Than the Sun?
description:
A lightning channel can be about five times hotter than the Sun’s visible surface.

Lightning can heat nearby air to about 30,000 C, hotter than the Sun’s roughly 5,500–5,800 C photosphere.

The lightning channel is tiny and lasts only a fraction of a second; the Sun contains vastly more total energy.

The explosive expansion of superheated air creates thunder.
